08526 Talmay {tal-mai'}

源自 08525; 陽性專有名詞 人名

欽定本 - Talmai 6; 6

撻買 = "犁溝"
1) 巨人亞衲的三個兒子之一
2) 基述王亞米忽之子, 他是基述末期的國王, 瑪迦的父親, 瑪迦是押沙龍的母親及大衛的妻子
record.edic_text:
08526 Talmay {tal-mah'-ee}

from 08525;; n pr m

AV - Talmai 6; 6

Talmai = "furrowed"
1) one of the 3 sons of the giant Anak who were slain by the men of Judah
2) son of Ammihud, king of Geshur, later king of Geshur himself, and
   father of Maacah, the mother of Absalom  and wife of David
